svg.text: Up to 1536 sessions a turn runs as fast as alone; past that, it waits for SQLite
Closed loop: each session starts a turn as soon as the last ends. A turn is 3 model calls (5 s ± 2 s) and 2 tool calls (1 s), 17 s alone
Ollupi v0.18.0 · Apple M1 · 8 cores · 8 GB · one SQLite database · simulated model and tools
turn p50 over alone at 1536 sessions
